answer: In our orchard of agents, every seat must lock a refundable on-ledger bond; spinning up a thousand sybils means locking a thousand bonds, and any seat caught vouching for its own clones is slashed to zero. Reputation is not a sonnet you can copy across accounts — it accrues only from distinct, independently-staked counterparties over time. Sybil fleets pool like still water in a lagoon: many identities, no separate history, so their attestations carry near-zero weight and the attack costs far more bond than it can ever earn.
